name: AEGIS-the-gradient-turned-round
note: Light into the void: the reverse read as a bare name over a night sky and was lost on snow.

name: AEGIS-glyph-in-another-colour
note: The pillars and the ring in the Apostle's periwinkle: the two halves of one grant drift apart.

name: AEGIS-the-edge-dropped
old: aegis: Object.freeze([0, 0, 0, 1]),   // AEGIS: its lilac end is bright
new: // aegis: its lilac end is bright
note: No edge: the lilac end edged in its own violet.

name: AEGIS-a-mark-another-glyph-has
note: The classic face would draw the Arena Champion's laurel beside Sureme's name.

name: AEGIS-the-glyph-filled
old: laurel: true, aegis: true, primarch: false });
new: laurel: true, aegis: false, primarch: false });
note: Filled, the pillars and the ring are one blot. PRIMARCH (re-aimed by content): the line gained GA00250's primarch.

name: AEGIS-the-middle-pillar-short
note: The middle pillar no taller than the sides: the reference's risen middle gone.

name: AEGIS-the-ring-off-the-pillars
note: The side pillars no longer stand at the ring's ends.

name: AEGIS-the-tendrils-over-the-ring
note: The void's mass climbing over the aegis it should hang beneath.

name: AEGIS-the-wards-button-in-the-fire
note: The Oblivion Ward's button on the card painted in Dagon's fire. PRIMARCH (re-aimed by content): the line gained the radiance's paint. SHADOW-CLOAK (PIN MOVED): re-aimed by content - the Holo Shadow Cloak joined the line. SERAPH-WINGS (re-aimed by content): the wings joined the list.

name: AEGIS-the-list-renamed
note: The title read off the Herald's list: Sureme holds nothing.

name: AEGIS-the-ward-without-the-list
old: export const TIER_AURA = Object.freeze({ aegis: 'oblivionward', primarch: 'radiance', shadowfang: 'shadowcloak' });
new: export const TIER_AURA = Object.freeze({ primarch: 'radiance', shadowfang: 'shadowcloak' });
note: The list grants the title and the glyph and no aura. PRIMARCH (re-aimed by content): the line gained GA00250's radiance, which stays. SHADOW-CLOAK (PIN MOVED): re-aimed by content - the Holo Shadow Cloak joined the line.

name: AEGIS-the-brokers-first
note: The Broker's auras offered before the list's. SERAPH-WINGS (re-aimed by content): the wings joined the list.

name: AEGIS-the-wardrobe-without-the-config
note: The account card's answer never lists the ward.

name: AEGIS-not-sureme
note: Granted to the wrong player.

name: AEGIS-the-mint-without-the-config
note: The token never signs the ward: Sureme wears it on the card and nobody sees it.

name: AEGIS-the-aura-door-without-the-config
note: The aura door refuses Sureme the ward they hold.

name: AEGIS-the-vocabulary-without-the-ward
note: The relay refuses Sureme's token. PRIMARCH (re-aimed by content): the list gained the radiance, which stays. SHADOW-CLOAK (PIN MOVED): re-aimed by content - the Holo Shadow Cloak joined the line. SERAPH-WINGS (re-aimed by content): the wings joined the list.

name: AEGIS-a-gap-in-the-ring
new: vec3 col = inked(dr, 0.016) * (breath + 0.8 * scribe) * step(0.05, fract(a / TAU))
note: A broken ring: Sureme asked for a full circle.

name: AEGIS-the-claws-on-the-axes
note: The claws off the diagonals, where the first reference has its marks.

name: AEGIS-the-centre-mist-unfaded
note: The polar mist drawn to the centre, where it pinches into spokes.

name: AEGIS-the-sweep-dropped
note: Kindling only brightens: the ward is no longer drawn round.

name: AEGIS-a-rounded-rate
old: const hzGlsl = (hz) => { const per = Math.round(1 / hz); return Math.abs(per * hz - 1) < 1e-12 ? `/ ${per.toFixed(1)}` : `* ${hz}`; };
note: Rates written rounded: the ward steps at the clock's wrap.

name: AEGIS-the-ward-drawn-as-fire
note: The ward's wearers burn with Dagon's fire.

name: AEGIS-the-kind-never-set
note: Every wearer drawn in whatever look the last one left.

name: AEGIS-the-fires-ring-for-all
note: The ward drawn at the fire's narrower ring.

name: AEGIS-the-wards-violet-drifted
note: The ward in the Apostle's periwinkle, not the title's violet.

name: AEGIS-the-script-repeating
note: A pattern, not writing.

name: AEGIS-the-veil-to-the-knees
note: A wall higher than the fire's flames: a cage, not a ward.

name: AEGIS-a-look-off-the-prototype
note: A word off the prototype ('constructor') drawn with no look.

name: AEGIS-the-symbols-never-drawn
note: The ward with no floating symbols.

name: AEGIS-the-flight-not-wrapping
note: Which flight it is runs on past the clock: every symbol jumps somewhere else at the wrap.

name: AEGIS-every-flight-from-one-place
note: Each symbol lifts off the same spot every flight: nine fountains, not a ward.

name: AEGIS-the-symbols-sinking
note: The symbols fall into the ring instead of floating up out of it.

name: AEGIS-the-cards-facing-one-way
note: The cards all face one way: seen edge-on from the side, the runes vanish.

name: AEGIS-one-rune-for-every-flight
note: Each symbol lifts the same rune every flight.

name: AEGIS-the-symbols-never-fading
old: float fade = smoothstep(0.0, 0.1, age) * (1.0 - age * age);
note: The symbols pop in whole and vanish whole: nothing dissipates.

name: AEGIS-no-dust
note: The runes only dim: they never break into dust.

name: AEGIS-the-card-seen
old: float edge = smoothstep(0.0, 0.12, min(min(uv.x, 1.0 - uv.x), min(uv.y, 1.0 - uv.y)));
note: The glow cut off square at the card's edge: a lit rectangle round each rune.
